name: account_manager
description: A jurisdiction-neutral double-entry ledger for a sole proprietorship that is also a household cash book. One ledger, two books, one currency; every stored posting is a balanced journal entry and each book balances on its own through a configured owner-draw pair. Ranges partition the ledger by transaction date, so a close freezes a month and an annual close posts the year's result into retained earnings before sealing the year. Nothing becomes a figure without the operator: CSV rows and transcriptions land as proposals that no report counts. The whole jurisdiction surface — chart of accounts, tax labels, fiscal year, import profiles — is configuration, and no tool's code holds an account name or a tax rate. Ships a bookkeeper-persona sub-agent that transcribes in and advises out but cannot post, confirm, discard, close or bind evidence.
author: Masaomi Hatakeyama
